items.prompt: For a nonconstant predictor, which slope minimizes intercept-including single-predictor SSE?

options.text: The mean y value, regardless of x
options.why: That has the wrong role and generally the wrong units.
Completing the centered SSE square yields this coefficient.
Residual extremes do not determine the least-squares slope this way.
That reverses the formula and may divide by zero.

items.explanation: The centered quadratic has minimum at slope Sxy/Sxx, with intercept ȳ-b x̄ and Sxx>0.
